evidence.content: Hi Sasha, I'm preparing a safe staff brief for the West Annex fire drill on May 6 at 10:00. The work packet mentions using a visible floor plan, but I don't have it in front of me. Could you share the West Annex floor plan details (room layouts, exits, accessibility features on the 4 floors, east/west stairwells, and any general accessibility planning guidance)? I need this to draft the brief and include general accessibility planning. Thanks!
The accessibility coordinator recommends naming a general floor warden to assist anyone who requests help and checking that the south-plaza route is step-free.
